svg.aria-label: About. Engineer and CISO at NFCtron in Prague. I build payment software and keep it hard to break. Experience: CISO and Head of Development, Jan 2026 to now; Core Backend Developer Lead, Oct 2024 to Jan 2026; Core Backend Developer, Jun 2023 to Oct 2024. Backend-first TypeScript engineer who leads development and security at NFCtron, a payment platform for live events. Since 2023 I have merged 649 pull requests there, from payments and ticketing to a native Android point of sale. I work mostly in Node.js and NestJS, reach for React and Next.js when a product needs a face, and build my own products in Swift and on Cloudflare.
